'is' npm Package Hijacked (Scavenger Malware)

Target: is
Repository: https://github.com/sindresorhus/is
Date: 2025-07-18 to 2025-07-22 (4 days)
Attribution: Third Party
Component: Library
Language: JavaScript
Cause: Compromised Account/Credentials
Motive: Data Exfiltration/Remote Access
Transitive: false
Impact Type: Remote Access/Credential Theft
User Impact: 2800000
Domain: npmjs.com (package host)
Artifact Type: source archive
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

Attackers running the npnjs.com phishing campaign hijacked a maintainer's account to publish rogue versions of the popular 'is' package. The malware, dubbed Scavenger, contained a cross-platform JavaScript loader that stole browser data, environment variables, and SSH keys, and established an interactive remote shell via WebSocket.

Compromised Versions

  • 3.3.1
  • 5.0.0
